info.name: Email Viewer
info.description:
### Email Viewer lets you view `.eml` and `.msg` files in Nextcloud.
It renders the email as a PDF in your browser and opens it in the PDF Viewer.
#### Requirements
- Nextcloud 28 or newer - Viewer and PDF Viewer for Nextcloud
#### Installation
- Download and enable files_emailviewer - Upload a `.eml` or `.msg` file and view it directly in Nextcloud 🙌
#### Limitations
- **Images from the internet are not shown.** Only images that are part of the email itself are shown. - **Interactive content is removed.** Forms and similar content do not appear. - **Some `.msg` files show no text.** Outlook can save the text of an email in its "Rich Text" format. This format is not supported, so a note is shown instead of the text. Other `.msg` files are shown as usual. - **Attachments are only listed.** The PDF names the attachments, but they cannot be opened from it.
